title: Isolate job-lane run data; share only via brokered observe or handoff
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He treats each pipeline as a JobLane: assets publishes refs that do not bleed to billing until an explicit `lane_handoff`, matching MH-DOTS-07 as productized JobLaneBroker. Focused claims also live in `fangore_job_lane_*` stories (same-lane lineage, cross deny, meta allowlist, artifacts, before selector, handoff).
